title: EvalDispute
description: A human's statement that one EvalResult is wrong: the 'This eval is wrong' control on any verdict, from Slack or web (HAR-97 E19 grader validity, E19-E22 eval-of-evals). Append-only supervision: a dispute never changes the EvalResult, its bundle, the send gate or company knowledge. disputed_verdict and disputed_blocking snapshot the result at dispute time, so eval-of-evals can count false passes (a pass the human says should warn or fail) and false blocks (a blocking fail the human says should not block) without re-reading the result.

eval_result_id.description: The EvalResult (eval_runs row) the human disputes.

disputed_verdict.description: The result's verdict when the human disputed it.

disputed_blocking.description: Whether the disputed result was a blocking failure.

expected_verdict.description: What the human says the verdict should have been. not_relevant: the eval should not have applied to this action. unknown (older spelling: abstain): the evidence was not enough to judge. Null when the human disputes the reasoning or the evidence without naming a verdict.

reason.description: In the human's words, what the eval got wrong.

allOf.description: An expected verdict differs from the disputed one; to dispute only the reasoning, leave it null.
